value.text:
- document:
  - banner:
    - heading "Open Kitchen Toolkit" [level=1]
  - navigation "Views":
    - link "Recipes":
      - /url: "#/recipes"
    - link "Imports":
      - /url: "#/imports"
    - link "Today":
      - /url: "#/today"
    - link "Approvals":
      - /url: "#/approvals"
    - link "Library":
      - /url: "#/library"
    - link "Settings":
      - /url: "#/settings"
  - main:
    - region "Today":
      - heading "Today — tasks" [level=2]
      - region "Scheduled work":
        - heading "Scheduled work" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Enabled rules run automatically while this workspace is open. Closing it stops processing; reopening performs bounded catch-up. Drafts never publish prices or place orders.
        - status:
          - text: "Worker:"
          - strong: idle
          - text: · next check 10/26/2026, 1:29:58 AM
        - group "Schedule settings":
          - text: Schedule settings Kitchen timezone
          - textbox "Kitchen timezone": America/New_York
          - text: Daily prep cutoff
          - textbox "Daily prep cutoff": 14:00
          - checkbox "Draft next service day prep"
          - text: Draft next service day prep
          - checkbox "Review recipes after confirmed purchase-cost imports"
          - text: Review recipes after confirmed purchase-cost imports
          - button "Save schedule settings"
        - group "Confirmed service forecast":
          - text: Confirmed service forecast
          - paragraph: Only currently approved recipe versions are used. Supply an explicit stock count, including zero when counted.
          - text: Service date
          - textbox "Service date"
          - text: Recipe
          - combobox "Recipe":
            - option "Choose a recipe" [selected]
            - option "DEMO Soup (synthetic)"
          - button "Add recipe to forecast" [disabled]
          - checkbox "I confirm the service demand and counted stock"
          - text: I confirm the service demand and counted stock
          - button "Save confirmed forecast" [disabled]
        - button "Check workflows now"
        - button "Refresh run history"
        - paragraph: No workflow runs yet.
        - region "Connected workflows":
          - heading "Connected kitchen work" [level=3]
          - paragraph: These runs link your source revisions, calculations, documents and approvals. Confirmed imports also create review work when cost-review schedules are enabled. No message, order or menu change is sent.
          - status: Created awaiting document draft.
          - group "Start a connected draft":
            - text: Start a connected draft Workflow
            - combobox "Workflow":
              - option "Recipe release" [selected]
              - option "Supplier price review"
              - option "Daily service"
            - text: Recipe
            - combobox "Recipe":
              - option "Choose a recipe"
              - option "DEMO Soup (synthetic)" [selected]
            - button "Create draft and review tasks"
          - paragraph: For event planning and service close, your locally connected AI can supply the structured budget, capacity, dietary and counted-stock inputs using the same connected-flow tools. The library lists the required inputs; missing evidence stays blocked.
          - button "Refresh connected work"
          - article:
            - heading "recipe release — recipe-release:1792978192091" [level=4]
            - paragraph:
              - strong: awaiting document
              - text: · revision 1
            - group: Calculations and supplied inputs
            - group: Sources and history
            - group: Add or revise a draft from your AI
          - article:
            - heading "daily service — daily-service:1792977239092" [level=4]
            - paragraph:
              - strong: blocked
              - text: · revision 1
            - heading "Resolve before approval" [level=5]
            - list:
              - listitem: Missing confirmed forecast and counted stock
              - listitem: Missing resource capacities and intervals
              - listitem: Missing verified ordering inputs
            - paragraph: Correct the source records, then create a new run so the earlier record stays inspectable.
            - group: Calculations and supplied inputs
            - group: Sources and history
            - group: Add or revise a draft from your AI
          - article:
            - heading "recipe release — recipe-release:1792977237559" [level=4]
            - paragraph:
              - strong: completed
              - text: · revision 4
            - group: Calculations and supplied inputs
            - group: Sources and history
            - group: Synthetic demo card (recipe card)
            - group: Synthetic demo SOP (sop)
            - group: Add or revise a draft from your AI
      - text: New task
      - textbox "New task":
        - /placeholder: Task title
      - button "Add task"
      - button "Refresh"
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "Title State Advance":
            - columnheader "Title"
            - columnheader "State"
            - columnheader "Advance"
        - rowgroup:
          - 'row "recipe-release: recipe-release:1792978192091 — awaiting_document open open"':
            - 'cell "recipe-release: recipe-release:1792978192091 — awaiting_document"'
            - cell "open"
            - cell "open":
              - 'combobox "state for recipe-release: recipe-release:1792978192091 — awaiting_document"':
                - option "open" [selected]
                - option "in_progress"
                - option "awaiting_approval"
                - option "completed"
          - 'row "recipe-release: recipe-release:1792977237559 — awaiting_document completed completed"':
            - 'cell "recipe-release: recipe-release:1792977237559 — awaiting_document"'
            - cell "completed"
            - cell "completed":
              - 'combobox "state for recipe-release: recipe-release:1792977237559 — awaiting_document"':
                - option "open"
                - option "in_progress"
                - option "awaiting_approval"
                - option "completed" [selected]
          - 'row "daily-service: daily-service:1792977239092 — blocked open (blocked: Missing confirmed forecast and counted stock; Missing resource capacities and intervals; Missing verified ordering inputs) open"':
            - 'cell "daily-service: daily-service:1792977239092 — blocked"'
            - 'cell "open (blocked: Missing confirmed forecast and counted stock; Missing resource capacities and intervals; Missing verified ordering inputs)"'
            - cell "open":
              - 'combobox "state for daily-service: daily-service:1792977239092 — blocked"':
                - option "open" [selected]
                - option "in_progress"
                - option "awaiting_approval"
                - option "completed"

Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
